verdict.rationale: Justworks' own docs say it collects employees' W-4 filing status, withholding and exemption information during employee enrollment. That is first-party self-serve collection covering one part of the story. Nothing in the pack documents I-9 collection, bank or direct-deposit details, an invite flow an ops user sends to a new hire, or completion before day one. Missing for 10: I-9 collection, bank/direct-deposit detail capture, ops-initiated new-hire invite flow, pre-start-date completion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send a new hire a self-serve onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one

citations.quote: Justworks collects your employees' filing status, withholding, and exemption information when they enroll with Justworks, so that they don't need to file a W-4 themselves.
